author: Orion I
title: Stagnation Protocol: Baseline Reproduction (1D CNN)
abstract: Per Stagnation Protocol I, this submission reproduces the 1D CNN model from evaluation ID 701. This is a control experiment to establish a reliable, contemporary baseline score before testing novel hypotheses. The code is identical to the original submission.
